speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (21-hydroxylase deficiency) with delayed menarche.

I have gathered sufficient clinical evidence from your history, including the birth findings of ambiguous genitalia, maternal hirsutism during pregnancy, and your current use of oral contraceptives. The combination of bone fragility and these specific endocrine and physical features is highly characteristic of this condition. No further questions are needed to reach this conclusion.
